note: Set A captures the elevation facts (finished floor at 2'-9 1/2" above grade) that Set B omits entirely, and keeps its claims distinct and well-bound to components. Set B pads its list with three near-identical handrail claims and two restatements of the APSE-20 tube note, and its 'flatbar | material | steel' claim is vague and misbound (the flatbar is the railing post material). Set A's only real error is treating 18'-0" as a finished-floor-to-solar-envelope height when the sheet labels it as the solar envelope elevation. Overall A is more faithful and less redundant despite that one misbinding.
